method: Codex CLI imagegen skill, built-in image_gen
usage: Illustrative scenery and packaging only; not product efficacy evidence or exact packaging.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: independent production landscape photograph for the approved Living Fields website.
Primary request: Generate a fresh wide panoramic photograph of a peaceful rice farm in morning light, closely matching the scenic composition described by the approved visual reference.
Composition/framing: Wide 16:9 landscape, native resolution 2560x1440 pixels or greater. Pale blue sky fills the upper 45 percent. Sun rising on the far left, layered misty low mountains in the middle distance, lush green rice fields below, sunlit grasses in the foreground.
Lighting/mood: Peaceful natural morning sunshine, warm sunlight with pale blue sky, soft valley mist.
Constraints: Opaque photographic image. The approved page is visual reference only; create a separate fresh landscape, never crop or reproduce its website layout. This scenic asset is illustrative, not efficacy evidence.
Avoid: Text, lettering, UI, cards, borders, logos, bottles, products, watermarks.
assets.processing: WebP quality 84 at native 1672x941. No upscaling; native resolution below requested 2560x1440.

limitations: Native output is 1672x941, below requested minimum 2560x1440. Tool exposes no explicit size parameter; requested resolution in prompt was not honored. No upscaling, fallback or reroll performed.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: independent transparent production bottle illustration for the approved Living Fields website.
Primary request: Isolated white agricultural liquid bottle with a ribbed pale grey cap, restrained softly shaded photographic product rendering. This is explicitly an illustration, not real packaging.
Composition/framing: Portrait, native resolution at least 512x1024 pixels. One full upright bottle viewed from the front, with comfortable transparent margins around its cap, sides and base. Rounded shoulders and white body.
Materials/textures: White plastic bottle, ribbed pale grey screw cap, subtle natural soft base shadow with translucent alpha.
Label: FRONT label area completely blank white; the semantic crop-color label will be placed separately in the UI. No printed or colored label.
Constraints: GENUINE native transparent alpha background, including transparent corners and space around bottle. Keep full bottle visible. Render the isolated bottle only.
Avoid: Text, brand, logo, badge, certification, markings, colored label, background scenery, opaque backdrop, fake checkerboard transparency, watermark.
assets.processing: Threshold native alpha at 88%, trim transparent margins and resize to 640px tall. Removes translucent grey halo; label remains semantic HTML.

limitations: Visible red/yellow speckle artifacts and subtle shading prevent compliance with clean flat gold-only mark requirement. No reroll or postprocessing performed.
